Happy Independence Day 2025: Here's a list of wishes and quotes you can share with your friends, family and lived ones to celebrate August 15.

"At the dawn of history, India started on her unending quest, and trackless centuries are filled with her striving and the grandeur of her success and her failures." – Jawaharlal Nehru (File Photo)

"They may kill me, but they cannot kill my ideas. They can crush my body, but they will not be able to crush my spirit." – Bhagat Singh (Image: Wikimedia Commons)

"Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom!" – Subhas Chandra Bose (Image: Wikimedia Commons)

"Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it." – Bal Gangadhar Tilak (Image: Wikimedia Commons)

"I will not surrender my motherland. I will fight till the last drop of my blood." – Rani Lakshmibai (Image: Wikimedia Commons)
7/10
"Let’s salute the sacrifices that gave us this freedom. Proud to be Indian. Jai Hind!" (Image: AI-Generated)
